issue: Hardcoded English string Content="↓ Update" on the update-notification download button is not routed through Strings.cs, so Russian-locale users see an English button.
fix: Use the existing localized update text or add one localized property and bind the button content.

issue: Read-mode rule rows use fixed columns wider than the detail pane at the supported minimum window width, clipping the value column or delete action.
fix: Use the existing IsRulesNarrow state to switch this row to a two-line narrow layout.
